zh_CN: 宁华的几家大平台把天南海北的家常话都拢在同一个热榜底下。早上通勤群里刚冒头的牢骚，还没到午饭点就已经传遍好几座城了。
en: A handful of big platforms gather everyday chatter from every corner of Ninghua under the same trending list. A gripe that pops up in a morning commuter chat can cross half a dozen cities before lunch.

zh_CN:
“无穷的远方，无数的人们，都和我有关。”
鲁迅《“这也是生活”……》
en:
“The boundless distance and countless people are all connected with me.”
Lu Xun, “This Too Is Life”...

zh_CN: 顺嘴的口头禅最容易被拿去往各种新场面里套；外头传进来的梗要是没人先补一段前情提要，本地人往往懒得接茬。
en: Catchy phrases get slotted straight into whatever new scene comes along. Imported jokes from abroad usually need someone to supply the backstory first, or locals won't bother picking them up.

zh_CN: 工作、教育、住房、生活成本
审核、自发性解构、品牌节庆
压力口头禅、消费笑话、粉圈图像
en: Stress catchphrases; consumer jokes; fandom images

zh_CN: 汐原的圈子大多围着一部部具体作品聚拢。新番新游刚露面，学生论坛当晚就能截出整楼细节，连完结多年的老物也常年有人考据翻新。
en: Online circles in Shiohara mostly gather around specific titles. The night a new show or game drops, student forums fill whole threads with frame-by-frame screenshots, while series that ended years ago still draw fresh deep-cuts and annotations.

zh_CN:
“不畏雨，也不畏风。”
宫泽贤治《不畏风雨》
en:
“Not losing to the rain, not losing to the wind.”
Kenji Miyazawa, Ame ni mo Makezu

zh_CN: 随手甩出的一句台词或反应图，底下往往拖着一整段原作剧情；改图的人也习惯留点眼熟的蛛丝马迹，专等懂行的同好对上暗号。
en: A casual line or reaction image often trails a whole scene from the original work behind it. People editing images leave familiar clues in place, waiting for fellow fans in the know to catch the signal.

zh_CN: 文娱、档案、身份认同、社区
新作上线、连载休止、社群争论
en: New releases; publication hiatus; community disputes

zh_CN: 角色反应图、旧作引用、日常四格
en: Character reactions; older works; everyday comic panels

zh_CN: 瑞原的同好小群抱团很紧，有人专门蹲物料，有人连夜翻字幕，只要前头约好时间，几十个小群能同时把一条词条刷出动静。
en: Tight-knit fan chats in Seowon move in lockstep: some camp out for fresh drops, others translate captions overnight, and once a time is agreed upfront, dozens of small groups can push a tag into view together.

zh_CN:
“愿直到死去那天，仰望天空也没有一点羞愧。”
尹东柱《序诗》
en:
“Until the day I die, may I look up at the sky without a speck of shame.”
Yun Dong-ju, Foreword

zh_CN: 不管是搞应援还是做二创都讲究打配合。圈内黑话能让自己人一眼认出彼此，就是一旦飘到外头，路人多半得等好心人翻译。
en: Support projects and fan remixes alike run on teamwork. In-group slang lets regulars spot their own at a glance, though once a post drifts outside the circle, passersby usually have to wait for a kind soul to translate.

zh_CN: 文娱、身份认同、技术工具、语言
应援接力、同步活动、解释分裂
en: Fan relays; coordinated events; divided interpretations

zh_CN: 应援口号、反应图、圈内暗语
en: Fan slogans; reaction images; insider language

zh_CN: 阿尔登的商业平台整天被新帖冲刷，风向变得极快，早高峰地铁上刚刷到的新梗，下班再点进去可能已经换了三茬意思。
en: Alden's commercial platforms stay flooded with fresh posts all day, and the wind shifts fast: a joke you scroll past on the morning train may have changed meaning three times by the ride home.

zh_CN:
“我也歌唱美利坚。”
兰斯顿·休斯《我也》
en:
“I, too, sing America.”
Langston Hughes, I, Too

zh_CN: 好套用的现成模板在这儿传得最快，品牌官号和普通网友挤在同一条时间线上抢眼球，连同一张配图都能被对立的两拨人拿去互呛。
en: Ready-made templates travel fastest here. Brand accounts and ordinary users jostle for eyeballs on the same timeline, and two opposing camps will happily grab the exact same image to dunk on each other.

zh_CN: 技术工具、科学、工作、公共议题
en: Technical tools; Science; Work; Public issues

zh_CN: 热榜助推、品牌借用、争议循环
en: Trending boosts; brand appropriation; controversy cycles

zh_CN: 通用模板、愤怒诱饵、名人反应图
en: Generic templates; outrage bait; celebrity reactions

zh_CN: 韦列斯克的学生论坛最爱翻老图出来配眼下的糟心事，房租涨了、平台改版了，随手换两行冷飕飕的字就能接着转一轮。
en: Student forums in Veresk love digging up old pictures to match whatever went wrong today. Rent goes up, a platform redesigns its layout, someone slaps two chilly lines on an old image, and off it goes for another round.

zh_CN:
“你们笑什么？你们笑的是自己！”
尼古拉·果戈理《钦差大臣》第五幕
en:
“What are you laughing at? You are laughing at yourself, oh you!”
Nikolai Gogol, The Government Inspector, Act V

zh_CN: 这儿的人说话爱端着一脸正经讲反话，对白越荒唐越有人接；外人想听明白笑点在哪儿，通常得先打听清楚他们最近又在烦什么。
en: People here deliver irony with a straight face, and the more absurd the exchange, the faster others pile on. Outsiders trying to find the punchline usually have to ask what everyone has been annoyed about lately first.

zh_CN: 住房、生活成本、档案、身份认同
旧梗复兴、反讽直译、集体改名
en: Old meme revival; literalized irony; collective renaming

zh_CN: 旧图新字、荒诞台词、本地双关
en: Recaptioned images; absurd dialogue; local puns

zh_CN: 林达尔地方不大，线上公共讨论像熟人串门一样通气，外头的风声传进来快，聊到最后又总会落回自家学区和社区门诊这些实在事上。
en: Lindal isn't big, and public threads online carry the easy back-and-forth of neighbors dropping in. Outside news arrives fast, yet conversations almost always circle back to concrete local matters like school districts and neighborhood clinics.

zh_CN:
“世界上最强大的人，是最孤立无援的人。”
亨利克·易卜生《人民公敌》第五幕
en:
“the strongest man in the world is he who stands most alone.”
Henrik Ibsen, An Enemy of the People, Act V

zh_CN: 本地网友转外地帖时总不忘替人补两句背景，平时最爱拿再熟不过的生活习惯自嘲；连公共机构下场玩梗，也会被街坊拎出来品头论足一番。
en: Locals forwarding posts from abroad make a habit of adding two lines of context, and spend the rest of the time poking fun at their own everyday routines. Even when a public agency tries using a meme, neighbors pull it aside to critique the delivery.

zh_CN: 医疗健康、家庭照护、教育、气候环境
地方议题、语境解释、机构借用
en: Local issues; contextual explanation; institutional appropriation

zh_CN: 日常自嘲、公共服务图、双语笑话
en: Everyday self-irony; public-service images; bilingual jokes

zh_CN: 马拉苏的港口城市与海外侨居圈子成天互通有无，挤车的上班族一边聊昨晚的球赛一边拼单省钱，只是各岛之间的网速和信号还差着一截。
en: Port cities in Marasu trade news nonstop with diaspora circles overseas. Commuters squeezed onto buses talk through last night's match while splitting bulk orders to save cash, though speeds and signal strength still vary sharply from island to island.

zh_CN:
“我要再活一千年。”
海里尔·安瓦尔《我》
en:
“I want to live another thousand years.”
Chairil Anwar, Aku

zh_CN: 一句话里掺两三种语言在这儿再平常不过，谐音梗和长辈表情包转得飞快，一趟趟跨语种搬运下来，意思常常越传越热闹。
en: Mixing two or three languages in a single sentence is ordinary here. Puns and elders' reaction graphics zip around fast, picking up livelier twists with every trip across languages.

zh_CN: 交通出行、语言、旅游、贸易
语码混用、翻译漂移、节庆热点
多语双关、家庭反应图、城市段子
en: Multilingual puns; family reactions; city jokes

zh_CN: 南美参考圈 · 聊天转发网络
在塞拉诺瓦，消息跑得最快的永远是大大小小的熟人聊天群，学生把课堂笑料和街坊传闻往群里一丢，亲友顺手转走的同时还不忘追问一句真的假的。
en: In Serranova, nothing outruns acquaintance group chats large and small. Students toss classroom bloopers and street rumors into the chat, and friends forward them right along while asking whether it's true or made up.

zh_CN:
“图书馆是无限而周期性的。”
豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯《巴别图书馆》
en:
“The Library is unlimited and periodic.”
Jorge Luis Borges, The Library of Babel

zh_CN: 球赛慢镜头和八点档连续剧的夸张表情，隔天就能被裁成满天飞的聊天贴图；换个群聊气氛，刚才拿来欢呼的图马上又能拿去诉苦。
en: Slow-motion match replays and over-the-top faces from eight-o'clock soaps get cropped into chat stickers overnight. Drop the same sticker into a different chat mood and yesterday's victory cheer turns straight into today's complaint.

zh_CN: 体育、文娱、社区、饮食与粮食
群聊接力、贴图截取、赛事热点
en: Group-chat relays; sticker extraction; sporting trends

zh_CN: 体育口号、连续剧反应图、聊天贴图
en: Sports slogans; television reactions; chat stickers

zh_CN: 撒哈拉以南非洲 · 多语创作网络
奥鲁维亚的年轻创作者最擅长从街头巷尾就地取材，堵车、菜价和打工受的气三言两语就能编成短对白，传去别的城市又会被改成当地版本。
en: Young creators in Oruvia pull their material straight off the street: traffic jams, market prices and workplace frustrations turn into punchy two-line dialogues in no time, then get rewritten into local versions in the next city over.

zh_CN:
“谚语是让话语下咽的棕榈油。”
钦努阿·阿契贝《瓦解》第一章
en:
“proverbs are the palm-oil with which words are eaten.”
Chinua Achebe, Things Fall Apart, chapter 1

zh_CN: 带着本地腔调的俗语一配进影视截图里就格外活灵活现；帖子跨区流转时，接手的人总会顺口把台词换成自家街面上常听见的说法。
en: Local idioms paired with movie stills come alive right away. Whenever a post crosses regions, whoever picks it up swaps the lines into the phrasing heard on their own block.

zh_CN: 工作、交通出行、饮食与粮食、技术工具
接入改善、本地对白、跨区域改写
en: Improved access; local dialogue; cross-regional rewriting

zh_CN: 城市日常对白、影视截帧、物价段子
en: Urban dialogue; film stills; price jokes

zh_CN: 常年在纳希尔城与萨法港之间跑动的人，把一路听来的新鲜事全捎进了街坊群，停水停电、集市行情这些家门口的安排，下班后还能聊上半宿。
en: People shuttling regularly between Nashir City and Safa Port carry everything they hear along the road straight into neighborhood chats. Water or power notices and market prices right outside the door can keep a thread going half the evening after work.

zh_CN:
“我是两种文明的儿子。”
纳吉布·马哈福兹，诺贝尔文学奖获奖演说（1988）
en:
“I am the son of two civilizations”
Naguib Mahfouz, Nobel Lecture (1988)

zh_CN: 这儿传消息讲究有名有姓有地方，大家习惯先问清楚话是从谁嘴里出来的，再拿几句干脆的问答把事情原原本本学一遍。
en: Passing news around here calls for names, faces and places. Folks expect to hear whose mouth a line came from first, then retell the whole business in crisp back-and-forth exchanges.

zh_CN: 饮食与粮食、能源、贸易、社区
索莱里亚的学生群一到晚上就格外热闹，刚散场的演出、还没踢完的球赛，连同兼职打工攒下的一肚子苦水，全能混在同一个帖子里聊到后半夜。
en: Student chats in Soleria come alive after dark: a show that just let out, a match still in stoppage time and a week's worth of part-time job gripes all end up tangled together in the same thread past midnight.

zh_CN:
“我的祖国是葡萄牙语。”
费尔南多·佩索阿《不安之书》
en:
“My homeland is the Portuguese language.”
Fernando Pessoa, The Book of Disquiet

zh_CN: 电影里的熟词常被拆成日常斗嘴的一问一答，连球场上的庆祝动作都能直接拿来当回复使，只要场面眼熟，谁路过都能顺嘴接上一句。
en: Familiar movie lines get broken into everyday banter, and goal celebrations double as reply reactions. As long as the scene looks familiar, anyone strolling past can toss in the next line.

zh_CN: 旅游、饮食与粮食、体育、文娱
阿文顿的文化圈子散落在各座老城与港口之间，一句新词刚跨过海峡或郡界，底下准有人先冒出来问一句：“这话搁你们那头到底算夸人还是损人？”
en: Cultural circles in Avendon sit scattered across old towns and harbors. No sooner does a new phrase cross a strait or county line than someone underneath asks, 'Does that count as a compliment or an insult on your side?'

zh_CN:
“真相很少纯粹，也从不简单。”
奥斯卡·王尔德《不可儿戏》第一幕
en:
“The truth is rarely pure and never simple.”
Oscar Wilde, The Importance of Being Earnest, Act I

zh_CN: 拿本地口音和鬼天气自嘲是家常便饭；一旦吵起公共议题，大伙儿既爱翻出几年前的旧报版面较真，也能为半句话里的阴阳怪气拉扯好几天。
en: Poking fun at local accents and rotten weather is daily bread here. Once a public argument starts, people will dig up newspaper pages from years back to check the record and spend days dissecting the snark in half a clause.

zh_CN: 公共议题、信任、语言、迁移与侨居
莱茵维亚的通勤群里三天两头有人翻出陈年海报或老电视片段，既能借古讽今吐槽手头的工作，聊兴起了又会一本正经考据起原片拍于哪一年。
en: Every few days in Rhenivia's commuter chats, someone digs up a vintage poster or old TV clip to gripe about work through a period lens, before getting sidetracked into dating the original broadcast to the exact year.

zh_CN:
“先得填饱肚子，才轮得到道德。”
贝托尔特·布莱希特《三分钱歌剧》第二幕终曲
en:
“First comes food, then morality.”
Bertolt Brecht, The Threepenny Opera, second-act finale

zh_CN: 喜欢追根溯源做归档的人和热衷给老图重配新词的人各占半边天，同一段几十年前的老录像能被翻出来用上百回，回回底下标的批注都不重样。
en: Archivists who track down every source and caption-writers who slap fresh jokes onto old pictures split the scene in half. One thirty-year-old clip can come back a hundred times with a different margin note underneath every run.

zh_CN: 米赫兰的学生论坛成天交换怎么省生活费、哪款联网工具更好使，从达里亚港飘进来的外来新词，往往也是在这儿先被人拆开揉碎、试着改成顺嘴的本地话。
en: Student forums in Mehran spend all day trading tips on stretching living allowances and picking reliable connection tools. Foreign slang drifting in through Darya Port usually gets pulled apart here first and reworked into natural local speech.

zh_CN:
“劳动是看得见的爱。”
纪伯伦《先知·论工作》
en:
“Work is love made visible.”
Kahlil Gibran, The Prophet, On Work

zh_CN: 实用的省钱门道总会被压成好记好转的顺口短句；等传进不同圈子，大家又会各自换上自家熟络的称呼和日常细节。
en: Practical money-saving tricks get boiled down into catchy one-liners built for forwarding. As the same line moves from circle to circle, each crowd swaps in its own familiar forms of address and daily details.

zh_CN: 生活成本、贸易、技术工具、语言
en: Living costs; Trade; Technical tools; Language

zh_CN: 坎塔利亚各城的文化小组隔着大片旷野在网上互通声气，讲座海报、演出排期和泛黄的老照片混着发，聊着聊着就会拐到各自上学和上班的经历上去。
en: Cultural groups in cities across Cantalia keep in touch online across wide stretches of open country, mixing lecture posters, gig listings and faded old photos until the thread inevitably turns to stories from school and work.

zh_CN:
“完美的午后慢慢成熟，慢慢褪色，慢慢收拢了花瓣。”
凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德《花园茶会》
en:
“And the perfect afternoon slowly ripened, slowly faded, slowly its petals closed.”
Katherine Mansfield, The Garden Party

zh_CN: 远道传来的流行梗常跟本地掌故摆在一块儿用，有人爱在底下老老实实补注出处，有人干脆把主角换成自己，改出一堆脾气各异的分支。
en: Viral jokes from far away sit right beside local lore. Some folks dutifully add source notes underneath, while others cast themselves as the lead and spin off a dozen versions, each with its own temper.

zh_CN: 家庭照护、气候环境、教育、医疗健康
维沙拉挤早班车的职员一路都在手机上互通有无，菜价涨落或是哪个常用软件又改了按钮，人还没走到工位，就已经被编成全办公室秒懂的段子了。
en: Early-bus commuters in Vishara swap news on their phones the whole ride in. A jump in vegetable prices or a moved button in a favorite app turns into an office-wide inside joke before anyone even reaches their desk.

zh_CN:
“在那里，心灵无所畏惧，头颅高高昂起。”
拉宾德拉纳特·泰戈尔《吉檀迦利》第35首
en:
“Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high;”
Rabindranath Tagore, Gitanjali, poem 35

zh_CN: 不同圈子都靠一套亲疏分明的称呼和暗语认人；外头来的说法只要一进群，用不了半天就会被改得满是当地茶水间和街市的烟火气。
en: Every circle tells insiders from strangers through finely graded nicknames and shorthand. Give an outside catchphrase half a day in a local chat and it comes out steeped in the everyday bustle of break rooms and street markets.

zh_CN: 交通出行、饮食与粮食、技术工具、教育
请从游戏主界面打开模因工作台。
en: Open the meme workbench from the main game screen.
